## Figure 2c: Heatmap, no precursors
```{r}
mapping_scores <- read.csv("~/Scratch_MF/2026_Falis_et_al/Figure2/2c/SixSpecies_CellType_MappingScores.txt")
mapping_scores <- mapping_scores %>% column_to_rownames("X") %>% as.matrix()

## Excluding the results involving precursors
to_exclude <- c("mm_precPTGC", "mm_precSTGC", "mm_precSpT", "mm_precSynTI", "mm_precSynTII", "rn_precPTGC", "rn_precSTGC", "hs_cCTB", "hs_fCTB", "cj_fCTB", "oc_SynTIILike", "rn_precSynTI")
mapping_scores <- mapping_scores[!(rownames(mapping_scores) %in% to_exclude), !(colnames(mapping_scores) %in% to_exclude)]

## adjusting species names
colnames(mapping_scores) <- gsub(pattern = "hs_", replacement = "HUM_", x = gsub(pattern = "cj_", replacement = "MAR_", x = gsub(pattern = "oc_", replacement = "RAB_", x = gsub(pattern = "cp_", replacement = "GUI_", x = gsub(pattern = "mm_", replacement = "MOU_", x = gsub(pattern = "rn_", replacement = "RAT_", x = colnames(mapping_scores)))))))
rownames(mapping_scores) <- colnames(mapping_scores)

# Adding row annotation
row_groups <- gsub(pattern = ".*_", replacement = '', x = rownames(mapping_scores))
row_groups <- row_groups %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("cell.type" = ".") %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(cell.type %in% c("CTB", "LaTP", "TrophProg", "JZTP") ~ "Progenitors",
                           cell.type %in% c("STB", "SynTI", "SynTII") ~ "Multinucleated",
                           cell.type %in% c("EVT", "SpATGC", "InvTroph", "GlyT") ~ "Migratory",
                           cell.type %in% c("SpT", "STGC") ~ "Other")) %>%
  pull(group)
col_groups <- row_groups
group_colors <- c("Migratory" = "#C982B8", "Multinucleated" = "#08418F", "Progenitors" = "#E69500", "Other" = "#1D7874")


row_anno <- rowAnnotation(
  CellClass = row_groups,
  col = list(CellClass = group_colors), 
  show_legend = FALSE,
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

col_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  CellClass = col_groups,
  col = list(CellClass = group_colors),
  show_legend = FALSE,
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

p <- Heatmap(
  mapping_scores,
  name = "Mapping Score",
  col = colorRamp2(c(0, 1), c("white", "darkgreen")),
  clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
  clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2",
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  show_column_dend = TRUE,
  show_row_dend = TRUE,
  right_annotation = row_anno,
  bottom_annotation = col_anno,
  column_names_rot = 90,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 22),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 25, fontface = "bold"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 25),
    color_bar = "continuous",
    border = NA,
    legend_height = unit(6, "cm"),
    legend_width = unit(10, "cm"),
    grid_width = unit(0.6, "cm"),
    title_position = "topcenter",
    direction = "horizontal"))


png("Visuals/2c_SAMap_TrophoblastNoPrecursors_Heatmap.png", width = 4500, height = 4500, res = 300)
draw(p, padding = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "mm"), heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")
dev.off()

pdf("Visuals/2c_SAMap_TrophoblastNoPrecursors_Heatmap.pdf", width = 10, height = 11)
draw(p, padding = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "mm"), heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")
dev.off()

## Clean up
rm(list = ls())
```
